subsection.title: Core Ideal Use Cases
subsection.description: - Include one or more core ideal use cases for the confirmed Primary Persona. - Start each use case with the product intent it demonstrates. - State the concrete starting context. - Describe sequential user actions and the visible product response after each action. - End each use case with an observable completion result. - Keep only the behavior needed by the minimum PoC.
subsection.example:
**Core ideal use case: Practice a difficult expression**
**Intent:** Demonstrate that an adult learner can focus practice on an English expression they personally want to master.
| Step | Primary Persona action | Visible product response | Expected result | |------|------------------------|--------------------------|-----------------| | 1 | Enters an English expression | Creates practice questions about that expression | The learner can begin focused practice | | 2 | Answers the generated questions | Shows the result and saves the expression | The learner can see what needs more practice | | 3 | Opens the expression list | Shows the saved expression for another practice round | The learner can continue practicing later |
**Completion result:** The learner can solve expression-specific questions and find the expression again.
